The vendor directly providing **Buster.so** (at **buster.so**) is **Sprint Labs, Inc.** (doing business as **Buster**).

### Supporting Evidence:
According to the official **Terms of Service** governing the platform at `buster.so`:
* *"Subject to and upon compliance with the terms set forth herein, Sprint Labs, Inc ('Buster') will provide access to the Platform Service..."*
* *"Sprint Labs, Inc, doing business as 'Buster', will make reasonable efforts to ensure that the Buster platform and Platform Services are available..."*
* *"‘Buster Platform’ means the data insight software-as-a-service platform operated through the Site by Sprint Labs, Inc."*
* Subscription cancellation notices and administrative inquiries are directed to Sprint Labs, Inc at `founders@buster.so`.
